title: Is a Linear Probe Evidence of a Linear Representation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.22655v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The linear representation hypothesis holds that pretrained vision models encode generative factors as linearly decodable directions in feature space, and comes with a standard methodology: train a linear probe, declare a factor represented if accuracy is high. We show this test is too permissive. Asymptotically, any sufficiently rich feature map, including a random one, admits a linear readout, so high probe accuracy is consistent with two very different geometries: a true linear world model, where the latent-aligned subspace dominates the representation, or a kernel machine, where the latents lie linearly inside a much larger curved manifold. This distinction matters because the curved structure orthogonal to the probe is relevant for out-of-distribution generalization, robustness, and compositional transfer. translated_title: 线性探针是线性表示的证据吗？
translated_abstract: 线性表示假设认为，预训练视觉模型将生成性因素编码为特征空间中可线性解码的方向，并伴随一套标准方法：训练一个线性探针，若准确率高则宣称该因素被表示。我们证明这一测试过于宽松。从渐近意义上说，任何足够丰富的特征映射（包括随机特征映射）都能实现线性读出，因此高探针准确率与两种截然不同的几何结构相容：一种是真正的线性世界模型，其中与潜在变量对齐的子空间主导表示；另一种是核机器，其中潜在变量线性地嵌入在一个大得多的弯曲流形内部。这一区别至关重要，因为与探针正交的弯曲结构对于分布外泛化、鲁棒性和组合迁移都具有重要意义。我们提出三种非对称诊断方法来区分这两种情况：反向预测性、谱集中度以及分布外……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明线性探针的高准确率不足以证明线性表示的存在——即使是随机特征也能实现线性读出——并提出反向预测性、谱集中度等三种非对称诊断方法，以区分真正的线性世界模型与核机器式的弯曲流形表示。
en_tdlr: High linear probe accuracy is not sufficient evidence of a linear representation, since even random features admit linear readouts; the authors propose three asymmetric diagnostics (reverse predictivity, spectral concentration, and out-of-distribution behavior) to distinguish a true linear world model from a kernel-machine-like curved manifold.
